labels.text: Publish artifact to a public link
Switch to AGI Cloud to publish

S33.04.note: The prompt step itself (how the assistant turns a request into an artifact) was not traced in these files; the path above starts at the artifact screen, and how that screen is opened from the chat was not traced either.
steps: Sign in to AGI Cloud and make sure the app is in AGI Cloud mode (not Local).
In the chat, ask the assistant to build a small one-page website.
Open the page the assistant creates so the artifact screen appears.
Tap the globe icon labelled 'Publish artifact to a public link'.
Compare: the globe icon turns green and a link appears under the page (Expected: the site is hosted).
S33.04.where: Chat > ask the assistant for a small web page > open the page it makes > tap the globe icon 'Publish artifact to a public link' in the top bar

S33.07.note: No separate preview deployment was found. The only publish action creates a shared link (shareUrl in apps/mobile/src/features/chat/services/artifactPublishing.ts); 'Preview' in ArtifactFullScreen.tsx is an in-app view, not a shareable URL. Searched rg -i 'preview|deploy' in ArtifactFullScreen.tsx and artifactPublishing.ts, and rg -i 'deploy' across apps/mobile/src.

labels.text: Publish artifact to a public link

S33.10.note: The 'Open in Safari' / 'Open in browser' text is returned by a function in ArtifactFullScreen.tsx and was not checked on screen; the 'Anyone with the link' visibility option is in PublishedArtifactControls.tsx.
steps: Open a page that was made by the assistant and tap the globe icon 'Publish artifact to a public link'.
Wait for the globe icon to turn green and for the 'Who can open this' section to appear below the page.
Tap 'Open in Safari' (or 'Open in browser' on Android).
Compare: the published site opens in the system browser at a public web address (Expected: a public URL).
S33.10.where: Artifact screen > globe icon 'Publish artifact to a public link' > 'Publish' > 'Open in Safari' (iPhone) or 'Open in browser' (Android)

S33.23.note: No control to roll a live published site back was found. The nearest control is 'Restore version N' with 'Version history' (ArtifactFullScreen.tsx and ArtifactVersionHistorySheet.tsx), but restoreArtifactVersion in apps/mobile/src/features/artifacts/store.ts only changes the local artifact and queues an artifact sync; it does not republish the live site. Searched rg -i 'rollback|roll back|rolled back' in apps/mobile/src and found only test comments.

S33.26.note: Only one source file is exported per artifact (artifactExport.ts); a multi-file site is not packaged as a project. The option label for code is built as a template in apps/mobile/src/features/chat/utils/artifactExport.ts ('<EXT> file' or the file name), so its exact text was not fixed.
steps: Open a code page made by the assistant (for example an HTML page) so the artifact screen appears.
Tap the download icon labelled 'Download artifact'.
If a choice list titled 'Download' appears, pick the option that says 'The source exactly as written'; otherwise the system share sheet opens with the file.
Compare: the share sheet offers a file with the page's source code (Expected: the owner downloads the source).'
S33.26.where: Artifact screen > download icon 'Download artifact' (top bar)
